mandatoryCriteria: Only current Owner/Manager of active project+granted active board can upload/commit/map/cancel; actual read refusal clears protected rows and disables writes. Explicit inaccessible project/board never falls back. Preserve selected synthetic file on validation failure; no automatic repeat upload after uncertain response.

Import URL carries returned batch id for authorized reload recovery; real status polling covers uploaded/validating/committing, never treats every2xx as committed. Ready/invalid/failed/expired/cancelled have honest terminal/recovery UI; only actual committed state produces created-card success.

Preview and result rows follow every actual limit/cursor page. Bind pages to batch version/state/digest; changed batch or409 gives explicit in-place reload while keeping local mapping choices. Server counts and loaded counts remain distinct.

Unknown workbook status strings can map to actual existing destination columns via POST mappings with expectedVersion. Only explicit complete current mapping save; no inferred default for unknown people/status, preserve drafts on conflict/refusal.

Explicit atomic commit confirms whole batch and retains original input/key across unknown replies. Fields/mappings/cancellation/new import lock until original commit resolves; same-tab draft/controller retained actor/batch. Actual committing response is processing, not done.

Committed receipt displays batch id/current status/server counts and provenance, every available created row links to original board/card. Download server-generated safe CSV using same-origin authenticated attachment path; never recreate unsafe CSV from workbook strings. Cancel only when backend cancellationAllowed, visible failure and no fake success; import another only after safe state.

Meaningful boundary/state tests exact statuscursor/mapping/commit identity/state transitions/source links. Run web suite/typecheck/build with retained logs; root owns actual Chrome+localAPI+PG and immutable finalreview, hostedUAT follows deployment.
scope: apps/web only plus review evidence. No backend/sharedcontracts/dependencies/cloud/deployment edits. Mapping backend key is original source status; UI only maps currently unknown source labels; no invented arbitrary headers/people creation.
